finding_reverify.prior_finding: Important: CPU-only or otherwise incomplete healthy resource samples pass guest readiness and native resource admission; archived positive replay strips all but CPU.
finding_reverify.evidence: Both guest readiness and native admission call the same isCompleteResourceSample validator for the relevant event kinds. It requires an object (not an array) and finite numbers in all eleven canonical sampler fields. The archived positive replay now supplies the full captured event objects. Independently executed the extracted production readiness function against the actual archived four-event sequence: healthy_samples=3, policy_samples_required=3, elapsed=6000ms, six native probe calls. Independently executed 52 negative source-level readiness cases, including 44 one-field missing/null/string/infinite mutations, four whole-sample shapes, busy reset, pending/stale native gate, and unsafe watch; all refused. Focused native test executes 44 field/value mutations across latest, pending, and recovered paths.

verdict_a.evidence: Archived run 39386228485-1 has CPU_PENDING busy .92, CPU_PENDING empty reasons .02, CPU_PENDING empty reasons .07, then CPU_RECOVERED empty reasons .13, each with all eleven measurements. Current helper counts the latter three and resets on busy, while checking current native health before release. Actual archived replay passed independently. Policy file was untouched; healthySamplesToResume remains 3, hosted deadline remains 90 seconds, and the existing native probe retains its fresh-health, stop, owner, unsafe, and pending checks.
verdict_a.limit: No native/browser/product execution or closure of other defects was attempted in this frozen review.

verdict_b.evidence: Shared validator closes the same malformed-sample class at the guest and native boundaries without duplicating the field list. The tests use actual captured full samples for the positive replay and exercise malformed fields at both call sites; 43/43 focused tests passed. The code diff does not alter the canonical sampler, resource policy, CPU thresholds, admission rules, or deadlines.
verdict_b.limitations: The focused suite was not mutation-planted in this review. Source-level and native test execution provide behavior evidence; live product verification remains outstanding.
